d: After getting separated and growing up differently, two orphan childhood friends reunite and later fall into trouble when they fall in love with the same woman.
Three friends travel to a small town where they meet Ragini, a gorgeous woman. However, their life changes as Ragini brings nothing but trouble to them.
Three scientists arrive at a village in search of a treasure. However, things take a turn when they explore a haunted palace and discover black magic.
A four-member task force sets out on the trail of a money launderer, Vicky Chaddha. However, the mission goes sideways when one of the members gets shot.
A master thief stumbles upon a secret lead about a shipment of gold ingots being transported from Russia to Romania. Eventually, he recruits a gang of sly criminals to stage a daring heist.
Tagore creates his vigilante military network or Anti-Corruption Force (ACF) with his former students to eliminate corruption in the society.
